name: ai-skills
description: A marketplace of Agent Skill plugins for writing clean, idiomatic code across stacks.

plugins.name: clean-code
plugins.description: Stack-aware clean-code best practices. Detects the project's framework and version, then loads only the matching guidance across frontend, backend, and shared core standards.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Source-agnostic first-pass code review across parallel dimensions, reported as Conventional Comments. Works on a local diff, a branch, or a GitHub or GitLab pull or merge request. Never approves or merges.
